company.shortDescription: LunaJoy helps women access mental care through virtual therapy, counseling, and medication management services.
company.description: LunaJoy helps women access mental care through virtual therapy, counseling, and medication management services. The company provides online women's holistic mental health counseling and therapy provided by licensed mental health counselors and therapists. It connects patients with medical providers who can virtually assess their needs and provide a variety of care options, such as holistic therapy, psychiatry, and mental health coaching, all over the phone or via video call. LunaJoy allows users receive one on one telemedicine sessions, wellness tools, and a holistic care plan that’s designed for them, as well as 24/7 access to the company's care navigation team.
